source: original database, actual MCP reads, supplied user prompts and approved Problem 6 plan
assignment_material_limit: No separate HW5 PDF, DOCX, notebook, syllabus, or handout found in HW5 or searched workspace; cannot verify materials not supplied.

schema.name: desk
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE desk (
            date_today TEXT NOT NULL,
            notes TEXT
        )

schema.name: inventory
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory (
            sku TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            size TEXT NOT NULL,
            qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
            location TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (sku, size)
        )

schema.name: pricing
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE pricing (
            sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            unit_cost REAL NOT NULL,
            list_price REAL NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: vendors
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE vendors (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
            lead_days INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: leases
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE leases (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            space_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            landlord TEXT NOT NULL,
            monthly_rent REAL NOT NULL,
            next_due TEXT NOT NULL,
            notes TEXT
        )

schema.name: cash_accounts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE cash_accounts (
            name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            balance REAL NOT NULL,
            date TEXT NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: payments
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE payments (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            ref_id INTEGER,
            amount REAL NOT NULL,
            account TEXT NOT NULL,
            paid_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            approved_by TEXT NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: invoices
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE invoices (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            vendor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            amount REAL NOT NULL,
            due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(id)
        )

schema.name: tickets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE tickets (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            type TEXT NOT NULL,
            requester TEXT NOT NULL,
            subject TEXT NOT NULL,
            sku TEXT,
            size TEXT,
            qty INTEGER,
            lease_id INTEGER,
            invoice_id INTEGER,
            status TEXT NOT NULL,
            notes TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (lease_id) REFERENCES leases(id),
            FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoices(id)
        )

mcp_tools.name: get_customer_order_context
mcp_tools.description:
Read a customer-order ticket, exact-size stock, pricing, linked invoice/vendor,
business date, and cash. Missing linked rows return null. Does not fulfill orders.

mcp_tools.name: get_rent_payment_context
mcp_tools.description:
Read a rent-notice ticket, linked lease, business date, accounts, all open
invoices, and all recorded payments. Payments are unfiltered because their
original kind/ref_id schema has no foreign keys. New payments use the
documented invoice/rent convention. Does not pay rent or approve spending.

mcp_tools.name: get_bulk_pricing_context
mcp_tools.description:
Read a price-override ticket, exact-size stock, all stock sizes for its SKU,
and recorded unit cost/list price. Other sizes are context, not substitutes.
Does not approve discounts, change pricing, or reserve inventory.

mcp_tools.name: initialize_shop_tools
mcp_tools.description: Human/backend setup only. Add operational tables to the working copy.

mcp_tools.name: get_ticket_context
mcp_tools.description: Read the ticket, shop date, and any operational records for this ticket.

mcp_tools.name: get_vendor_shipping_status
mcp_tools.description:
Read a vendor and all its open invoices. Shipping is blocked by any open bill.
A lead time is not a confirmed arrival; supplier/SKU mapping remains unspecified.

mcp_tools.name: request_payment_approval
mcp_tools.description:
Create a pending human request for the database obligation amount, never pay.
Refuse insufficient cash. Repeated requests for the same obligation are reused.

mcp_tools.name: get_payment_approval
mcp_tools.description: Read the stored payment request for this ticket, including human decision.

mcp_tools.name: record_human_payment_decision
mcp_tools.description: Human/backend only, never an agent tool. Decide a pending payment request.

mcp_tools.name: execute_approved_payment
mcp_tools.description: Execute only a stored human-approved payment; atomic and replay-safe.

mcp_tools.name: save_message_draft
mcp_tools.description: Store an unsent customer/vendor message draft. No communication is sent.

mcp_tools.name: save_quote_draft
mcp_tools.description:
Store a ticket-specific unsent quote at or above recorded cost. No approval,
global price change, revenue, or stock reservation is implied.

mcp_tools.name: plan_vendor_shipment
mcp_tools.description:
Store a shipment DRAFT using vendor lead_days only when no open invoice exists.
Requires supplied evidence for the SKU/vendor match. Never ship or add stock.

mcp_tools.name: fulfill_customer_order
mcp_tools.description:
Fulfill a customer_order from actual exact-size stock; atomically decrement
inventory and resolve ticket. Idempotent, no revenue or imagined restock.

mcp_tools.name: list_shop_tickets
mcp_tools.description: Read the three assignment tickets and their current stored statuses.

mcp_tools.name: get_checking_balance
mcp_tools.description: Read the actual checking account; no currency is inferred.

mcp_tools.name: get_cash_obligations
mcp_tools.description: Read cash, open invoices, leases, payments and shop date without switching tickets.

mcp_tools.name: list_approval_requests
mcp_tools.description: Read durable payment/purchase requests, including executed and denied ones.

mcp_tools.name: approve_and_execute_payment
mcp_tools.description:
Human-only: grant a pending payment and execute in ONE transaction.
Insufficient cash/stale obligations roll back the decision as well as payment.
An already-executed request returns its original payment without charging again.

mcp_tools.name: request_purchase_approval
mcp_tools.description:
Prepare a purchase for the ticket's exact product/size at recorded unit cost.
Require supplied supplier evidence. Never debit cash or invent received stock.
Only one pending/executed purchase per ticket; shipping block rechecked at approval.

mcp_tools.name: approve_and_execute_purchase
mcp_tools.description:
Human-only: atomically approve and record a prepared cash-out purchase.
Recheck price/product/shortage/lead time, vendor unpaid bills, and available cash.
Never add stock or contact a vendor; repeated approval is idempotent.

mcp_tools.name: deny_prepared_request
mcp_tools.description: Human-only denial of an unexecuted request; no spending.

mcp_tools.name: reset_working_database
mcp_tools.description:
Human-only reset via SQLite backup from original into the fixed working DB.
Recreate empty operational schema. Audit files remain untouched; original read-only.
